title: RHP prospectus extraction
description: Page-cited, verbatim extraction from an issue's RHP/DRHP PDF, written to data/site_v2/issues/<slug>/prospectus.json by scripts/extract_rich_rhp.py. THE differentiator. Every scalar fact is a `provenance_leaf` carrying a source page citation. Section internals are intentionally permissive (additionalProperties:true) because the extraction schema evolves; the stable contract is the envelope, the section set, and the leaf shape.

slug.description: Issue slug — matches issues/by-slug/<slug>.json and the containing directory.

meta.description: Extraction provenance for the whole document.

rhp_pdf_url.description: Resolved direct PDF URL (NSE zips are unwrapped to the inner PDF).

extraction_passes.description: One entry per section pass: section, in/out tokens, cached, page_range.

section.description: A top-level prospectus section. Internals vary by section and evolve with the extractor, so they are not constrained here — but every SCALAR fact within is a `provenance_leaf` (see below). A section may be absent if its extraction pass failed; render only sections that are present.

provenance_leaf.description: The universal leaf shape for every extracted scalar fact. The frontend renders `value` and surfaces `raw_excerpt` + `source_page` as a citation ("Source: RHP p.99"). Treat value:null or confidence:"low" as not-available — never fabricate.

value.description: The extracted value: string | number | boolean | null. Currency in integer paise, percentages in integer bps, multiples as decimal-string — mirroring the issue record's units.

raw_excerpt.description: Verbatim quote from the PDF supporting the value.

source_page.description: 1-indexed PDF page the value was found on.

source_section.description: The RHP section heading, e.g. "SECTION II - RISK FACTORS".
